noor (Design): quick pass on the compact control strip at the top of the Insights page — keyboard focus is almost invisible and VoiceOver doesn't announce the control group context. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/compact/strip.png :mag: pete (Frontend): which controls exactly? the quick toggles and the tiny icon buttons? noor (Design): the small icon toggles (auto-refresh, dense mode, csv export). visually they rely on subtle fill change on hover only. keyboard tab lands but you can't tell which control group you're in. rina (A11y): two issues: 1) focus indicator needs to be visible and meet focus contrast guidance; 2) for grouped controls we should use `role=toolbar` with `aria-label` so SRs announce "toolbar" and users know context. Also ensure each icon button has an accessible name (aria-label) — icons alone are not sufficient. pete (Frontend): current markup: `
...
` rina (A11y): replace title with `aria-label`, add `role=\"toolbar\" aria-label=\"Insights actions\"` on the container. For focus, use `outline: 3px solid var(--focus)` not a faint shadow. That outline must contrast with both light and dark backgrounds. noor (Design): i also want the toolbar to announce counts when toggles change state, e.g., "Auto-refresh enabled" — minimal phrasing. Use a polite live region for that. pete (Frontend): will do. also noticed dense mode toggles change the row spacing but we don't announce the change. i'll add announcer message like `Dense view enabled, showing compact rows` to SR region. sam (QA): test matrix: VoiceOver macOS, NVDA+Firefox, JAWS+Edge, ChromeVox. Tests: tab into toolbar, screen reader announces toolbar and each button label; focus ring visible and persists after keyboard nav; toggling triggers polite announcement; toolbar does not get skipped by quick navigation. rina (A11y): one more: ensure the toolbar respects reduced-motion — if toggles animate, prefer prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for SR users. Also ensure the announcer debounce is ~300ms so rapid toggles don't flood speech. pete (Frontend): CSS snippet: `.compact-strip[role=toolbar] .icon:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(79,70,229,0.95); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; }` JS announcer snippet: `announce(text){ clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(()=> announcer.textContent = text, 300); }` noor (Design): copy nit: use present tense and avoid screen reader verbosity. e.g., "Auto-refresh on" vs "Auto-refresh enabled" — i prefer the latter, clearer. rina (A11y): "Auto-refresh enabled" reads better with screen readers. Also check that icons have `aria-pressed` for toggle states. For export (one-off action) make it `role=button aria-label=\"Export CSV\"`. sam (QA): please include visual regression for focus ring so contrast changes don't accidentally affect layout. deploy-bot: accessibility-lint: compact-toolbar-focus (medium), toolbar-announce (low) https://ci.redwood/a11y/2412345678 pete (Frontend): estimate 2 dev hours: add toolbar role/label, change titles->aria-labels, focus CSS, announcer with debounce, and unit tests. PR -> https://git.redwood/pr/9210 (WIP). preview -> https://deploy-preview.redwood/9210 rina (A11y): i'll review once PR's up and run VoiceOver/NVDA checks. thanks team. noor (Design): thanks — small but important.
